ai_summary: AU Small Finance Bank reported robust preliminary Q2 FY27 results, with total deposits growing 28.6% YoY and the gross loan portfolio expanding 25.1% YoY, indicating strong business expansion. This growth is supported by a healthy 29.1% YoY increase in CASA deposits, maintaining a stable CASA ratio of 29.5%, which suggests sound and cost-effective funding. While these figures are provisional, they reflect strong operational performance with no immediate red flags.
